subject: CONTRACT tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_options: draw parameters (vertexStart/BaseVertex/BaseInstance) + extended varyings (flat/int/noperspective, <=16)
body:
Header mali_graphics_compiler.h 89ac4ff7, lib 57db4be4. Additive; existing entries unchanged bytes.
int tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_options(vs,vn,fs,fn, vc,nc,fc,nf, const struct tegu_mali_generic_options *o, &vso,&fso,&pair2,&gplan, struct tegu_mali_varying_info *vi, err,errn);
struct tegu_mali_generic_options{u32 version=1,flags,rt,reserved=0}. flags: DRAW_PARAMETERS 1, SELECT_RT 2 (rt 0..7, else rt must be 0), TILE_FETCH 4 (needs SELECT_RT), EXTENDED_VARYINGS 8 (vi must be non-NULL zeroed; without flag vi must be NULL). Invalid options => rc1, nothing written (not even err). flags 0 == _specialized, 2 == _specialized_rt, 6 == _specialized_tile_rt (tested byte-identical).
DRAW_PARAMETERS (render+textures n2r): VS VertexIndex = hw id + VB, BaseVertex = VB, InstanceIndex = hw instance + BI. VB = signed32 at VERTEX FAU byte 64 (TEGU_GRAPHICS_VERTEX_BASE), BI = uint32 at byte 68. vso.sysval_mask bit4 (0x10) / bit5 (0x20) says the VS reads them; fau_words already covers (17/18). Native MUST: write VB=vertexStart (drawPrimitives) or baseVertex (indexed) and BI=baseInstance at vertex FAU (n2r m+1664+64/+68) whenever the bit is set; keep MALI_PRIMITIVE.base_vertex_offset 0; rebase only hardware-fetched attributes (pair vs_attribute_mask / ATTRIBUTE rows) by VB*stride (per-vertex) and BI*stride (per-instance); do NOT rebase buffers the shader pulls by VertexIndex. Verified ISA: IADD.s32 r, r60(vertex_id), u8.w0. This lets render drop -13 for nonzero vertexStart with VertexIndex once n2r writes the word (needs a textures-owned request field). Default entries still fold base_instance:=0 and now REFUSE BaseVertex (was SIGABRT).
EXTENDED_VARYINGS: 32-bit float/int/uint scalar/vector, FS float smooth|noperspective|flat, int/uint flat; <=16 locations; centroid/sample/16-bit/relaxed still refused. pair2.varying_count/varyings[] are ZERO; list in vi->slots[count] {location,offset,components,alu_type(160 f32/34 i32/36 u32),interpolation 1 smooth/2 noperspective/3 flat/0 VS-only}; vi masks; pair2.noperspective_mask real (Mesa lowers it in-shader, no native work). VARY_SIZE still pair2.generic_size_B (n2r caps 64B). FLAT: if pair2.flags & TEGU_MALI_PAIR2_FLAT_SHADING (2), native MUST set arch9 TILER_CONTEXT.first_provoking_vertex=1 (word2 bit18; Metal/Vulkan first vertex) and for line lists DRAW.flat_shading_vertex=1; n2r currently leaves it 0 = LAST vertex => silent wrong flat values. textures: please add that (n2r tiler pack) gated on a shader flag; render: only consume EXTENDED when n2r supports it.
CACHE: options/tables must enter the persistent Mali cache key (pipeline_cache_frontend.inc, root-owned) as a new entry id incl. options struct, both tables and vi presence.
Still genuine unsupported: graphics TLS/spilling (needs LOCAL_STORAGE TLS alloc), viewport arrays/layer outputs, storage images in graphics, descriptor arrays, minLOD+gradients, sparse, compute physical pointers/BDA, compute private memory, float64 atomics.
